key_insight: Piccolo co-evolves multimodal decision models and training data through recursive self-improvement, emphasizing targeted data curation over model scale alone.
engineering_relevance: The approach offers a blueprint for improving decision systems through feedback-driven data workflows and coordinated research agents.
method: Predict probabilities over candidate answers for text and visual decisions.
Use research agents to analyze behavior, curate training data, and run experiments.
Connect iterative improvements through semantic slices and shared research memory.
evidence_signal: On Decision Index Vision Full, Piccolo-27B scores 75.59, while 9B and 4B score 68.35 and 67.46; all three rank first on the Private benchmark within their respective size categories.
watch_item: Falling training loss can coincide with worse discrete decision accuracy, so refinement requires direct evaluation of task-level outcomes.
paper_title: Piccolo: Co-Evolving Decision Models and Data through Recursive Self-Improvement
